content_sections.heading: About IIT Indore
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Indore is located at Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore. This notice, dated 19 November 2026, is for a post in its Department of Mechanical Engineering, in a funded research project on a digital platform and mobile application for the Modified Mini-Mental State Examination for Children (MMSEc).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Masters in Engineering with minimum 2 years of research, design and development experience and at least one research paper in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Desirable: candidates with exposure to development of web based applications, data science and cloud computing are encouraged to apply. For the discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The duration is one year, extendible till completion of the project.

rows.pay: Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA (as per funding agency rules)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Senior Research Fellow (SRF)
content_sections.text: Submit your information along with a detailed CV through the Submit Form Here link given in the notice (Application for SRF position form). Alternatively, send an email to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for SRF position in a Project". Send the application latest by 27 November 2026. Documents named in the notice: a detailed CV; documents in support of educational qualifications and experience certificates, which must be produced at the time of the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email to attend the interview. The notice does not give the interview date or venue. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Educational qualification and experience documents must be produced at the time of the selection process. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. HRA is paid as per funding agency rules.
